overlaps.proposal: When GN.4 needs the coordinate-polydisc packing/doubling subproblem, reuse the existing EffectiveBounds API after proving the real-lattice coordinate and finiteness adapters on the actual consumer carrier. GN.4 retains general covering/star-body questions, transference, Siegel averaging, equidistribution and their independent analytic/dynamical estimates. baselineChecks.provides: For every number field F, (Subgroup.square (O_F)^x).index <= 2^[F:Q]. The proof uses a Dirichlet fundamental system and torsion generator. This is exactly the Multiquadratic estimate input.
baselineChecks.checked: Actual statement and surrounding parameters read at the pinned commit; no compilation or exhaustive axiom audit claimed.

baselineChecks.provides: For finite iota, r_i>0, 0<epsilon<=c, and S in the coordinate polydisc with distinct x,y separated by epsilon*r_i < norm(x_i-y_i) for some i, S is finite and #S <= (4c/epsilon)^(2#iota). Strict separation and positive radii are retained.
baselineChecks.checked: Actual statement and surrounding parameters read at the pinned commit; no compilation or exhaustive axiom audit claimed.

baselineChecks.provides: For finite iota, positive r_i and additive subgroup Lambda of iota -> C, assuming Lambda intersect box(r,2) is finite, its cardinal is <= 49^(#iota) times that at scale 1. Finiteness is an input, not supplied by the displayed bound.
baselineChecks.checked: Actual statement and surrounding parameters read at the pinned commit; no compilation or exhaustive axiom audit claimed.

baselineChecks.provides: For an ambient characteristic-zero field A and N in N, number-field intermediate subfields K/Q in A with |discr K|<=N have cardinal <= (2C+1)^(D+1)*D, with the named coefficient bound C and degree bound D. This is not a weighted isomorphism-class asymptotic or a list-enumeration certificate.
baselineChecks.checked: Actual statement and surrounding parameters read at the pinned commit; no compilation or exhaustive axiom audit claimed.

baselineChecks.provides: For a number field K of unit rank zero, R_K=1 and hence 1<=R_K. Positive unit rank is not covered by this theorem.
baselineChecks.checked: Actual statement and surrounding parameters read at the pinned commit; no compilation or exhaustive axiom audit claimed.

baselineChecks.provides: The regulator is the covolume of the unit lattice; regulator_pos gives positivity. Definition and positivity do not constitute a chosen effective uniform lower bound.
baselineChecks.checked: Actual statement and surrounding parameters read at the pinned commit; no compilation or exhaustive axiom audit claimed.

baselineChecks.provides: For a rank(K)-indexed family of integral units, regOfFamily(u)/regulator(K) is the index of the subgroup generated by the family and torsion. Full-rank/finite-index hypotheses are needed before using this as a positive-index stopping bound.
baselineChecks.checked: Actual statement and surrounding parameters read at the pinned commit; no compilation or exhaustive axiom audit claimed.

followUp.detail: Pin a specific positive-rank regulator lower inequality and all hypotheses/source constants. Do not promote the historical completed header or rank-zero R=1 theorem into 1<=R for arbitrary number fields. The audit reports a partial positive-rank target; this screen does not prove absence from the whole library.

For a regulator-based unit stopping certificate, require a full-rank family u, a proved b(K)>0 with b(K)<=R_K, and a certified upper bound U on regOfFamily(u). The checked index comparison yields index<=U/b(K); saturation or a strict bound below 2 is still needed to conclude index 1. The square-subgroup bound is not an index bound for an arbitrary found family. No dependency on the unspecified L3 inequality is inserted.

Keep source-specific ramification/discriminant inequalities and finite-list completeness explicit. An upper bound on how many subfields may exist does not certify a candidate list, and a positive lower discriminant exclusion needs its own theorem. No quantitative-Hermite edge is guessed from the reference to EffectiveBounds.

Discharge the coordinate/polydisc and finiteness adapter on the GN lattice carrier before invoking the exact packing/doubling declarations. Keep uniform lattice asymptotics, transference and homogeneous dynamics in their own source-qualified development; the overlap recommendation is not a proof of those imports.
